title: Approval gate, deploy to staging, promote
summary: A deployment of an app to its staging target in the journeys' fixture project stops at its approval card: the journey asserts the card is waiting for a person and stops there. The journey account never approves its own deploy, and a production promotion always waits for a separate person (the account holds no deployment:production).

fixtures: a sandbox app in the fixture project with an active staging deployment target (staging_target)

acceptance.text: The staging deployment waits at its approval card for a person
